# PCB3 illumination experiment: PCB3 baseline (v2 pipeline) vs PCB3 candidate (v2 + global luminance standardisation)

*CONFIRMATORY: pre-registered (docs/illumination_experiment_protocol.md), single planned evaluation on PCB3, never used before.* Generated by `ivad illum-compare` from recorded per-image scores.

**Pre-registered outcome: ROBUSTNESS IMPROVEMENT SUPPORTED**

Thresholds (P95, frozen): baseline 46.597, candidate 47.717.

## Clean condition (official test 100 anomalies + 101 normals; holdout 155 normals)

| Metric | Baseline | Candidate | Δ (pts) [95% CI] | McNemar p |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Recall | 90.0% | 91.0% | +1.0 [-2.0, +4.0] | 1.000 |
| FPR, test normals | 3.0% | 3.0% | +0.0 [-3.0, +3.0] | 1.000 |
| FPR, holdout normals | 5.2% | 3.9% | -1.3 [-3.2, +0.0] | 0.500 |
| AUROC | 0.982 | 0.983 | +0.001 [-0.003, +0.007] | — |

Clean recall gate: pass; clean FPR gate: pass.

## Conditions (pooled unseen normals; test anomalies)

| ID | Perturbation | ΔFPR baseline | ΔFPR candidate | DiD FPR [95% CI] | ΔRecall baseline | ΔRecall candidate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | brighter_higher_contrast | +15.2 | +2.7 | -12.5 [-17.6, -7.4] | +1.0 | -1.0 |
| G1 (primary) | darker_lower_contrast | +4.3 | -0.4 | -4.7 [-8.6, -0.8] | +0.0 | +0.0 |
| N1 | illum_ramp_lr_1.0_0.8 | +2.0 | +2.3 | +0.4 [-2.7, +3.9] | +0.0 | -3.0 |

**Note:** the baseline's own G1 false-alarm rise is below 5 pts, so PCB3 did not reproduce the PCB2 failure and the primary endpoint is weakly informative on this board type.

Non-uniform illumination (N1): candidate FPR rise +2.3 pts, recall change -3.0 pts -> limitation exposed: **False** (exposed iff candidate N1 FPR rise > 0.1 or recall drop > 0.1 (original P5 limits)).

Sensitivity flag: **False** (deficits {'small': -1, 'low_contrast': 1}; flag iff candidate detects >= 3 fewer anomalies than the baseline in the small or the low-contrast tercile).

## Runtime

Median end-to-end latency: baseline 187 ms, candidate 292 ms. Correction step alone (CPU): 71.2 ms median.

## Original acceptance criteria (unchanged)

Baseline verdict: INCONCLUSIVE; candidate verdict: INCONCLUSIVE. N1 is excluded from P5 (not in the original definition).

Rule: supported iff DiD 95% CI upper < 0 and both clean gates pass; unfavourable iff a clean gate fails or DiD 95% CI lower > 0; otherwise inconclusive. Clean recall gate fails iff Δrecall < -0.05 or (Δrecall < 0 and McNemar p < 0.05); clean FPR gate fails iff candidate FPR > baseline FPR + 0.05 on official-test or holdout normals.
